note: `.faces(">Z").workplane().pushPoints([(1, 1, 3)]).hole(1)`: a hole from three above the face. The bore starts at z = 7 and runs the box's diagonal D = sqrt(116) down, to z = 7 - D = -3.77: short of the bottom, so it is blind there, its cylinder 4 - (7 - D) = D - 3 long inside the part. V = 192 - pi r^2 (D - 3); it takes the top disc, adds the wall 2 pi r (D - 3) and the cap disc at its end: A = 208 + 2 pi r (D - 3). The cut's centroid is (1, 1, (11 - D) / 2).
